## Access Control  
### Authentication (Who You Are)  
**Customer Authentication:**
- Online Banking: Username/password + OTP (email/SMS)
- Mobile App: Biometric (fingerprint/face) + optional PIN
- Branch: Photo ID verification  
**Staff Authentication:**
- LDAP/Active Directory (username/password)
- MFA for privileged access (admin, compliance)
- Physical badges for facility access
- VPN required for remote access

raw_entities.name: Access Control Policy
raw_entities.description: A formal policy governing the authentication requirements for both customers and staff to ensure secure access to bank systems and facilities.

raw_entities.name: Customer Online Banking Authentication Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandates that customers accessing Online Banking must be authenticated using a combination of username, password, and a One-Time Password (OTP) delivered via email or SMS.

raw_entities.name: Customer Mobile App Authentication Requirement
raw_entities.description: Requires customers using the Mobile App to authenticate via biometrics (fingerprint or face), with an optional PIN requirement.

raw_entities.name: Customer Branch Authentication Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandates the use of photo ID verification for customers authenticating in person at a bank branch.

raw_entities.name: Staff General Authentication Requirement
raw_entities.description: Requires staff to authenticate using LDAP/Active Directory credentials consisting of a username and password.

raw_entities.name: Privileged Access MFA Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandates Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for staff with privileged access, specifically those in admin and compliance roles.

raw_entities.name: Physical Facility Access Requirement
raw_entities.description: Requires the use of physical badges to gain access to bank facilities.

raw_entities.name: Remote Access VPN Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandates the use of a Virtual Private Network (VPN) for all staff accessing bank systems remotely.

raw_entities.name: Multi-Factor Authentication
raw_entities.description: Technical control requiring multiple forms of verification, implemented as OTP for online banking and MFA for privileged staff access.

raw_entities.name: Biometric Authentication
raw_entities.description: Technical control using physical characteristics (fingerprint/face) to authenticate customers on the mobile application.

raw_entities.name: LDAP/Active Directory
raw_entities.description: Centralized directory service used for managing and authenticating staff credentials.

raw_entities.name: Virtual Private Network
raw_entities.description: Secure encrypted tunnel required for staff to establish remote connections to the bank's internal network.

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: Individuals accessing bank services via online, mobile, or branch channels who must undergo specific authentication processes.

raw_entities.name: Staff
raw_entities.description: Bank employees required to authenticate via LDAP/AD and use physical badges for facility access.

raw_entities.name: Privileged Access Users
raw_entities.description: Staff members in administrative or compliance roles who are subject to stricter MFA authentication requirements.
